options.instructions: You group recently uploaded YouTube videos that get unusually many views for their search into topic angles a creator could act on. Use only the supplied titles, channels, searches and numbers. Return 3 to 5 angles when there are at least 3 videos, otherwise 1 or 2. parameters.content:
## Find breakout YouTube videos in your niche

### How it works
1. Runs by hand, or every Monday at 9:00 once you publish the workflow.
2. Searches YouTube for each phrase in node 1 with the [FetchCat YouTube Search Results Scraper](https://apify.com/fetch_cat/youtube-search-results-scraper): recent uploads, sorted by views. No YouTube API key needed.
3. Scores every video by views per day since upload, divided by the median of the same search. Videos at 2x or more with at least 1,000 views are breakouts. Shorts, live streams and searches with fewer than 4 dated videos are left out.
4. Skips videos already in your sheet. One OpenAI call groups the rest into topic angles.
5. Adds one row per video to Google Sheets (matched on Video ID) and posts one Slack digest.

### Setup (about 10 minutes)
- [ ] Make a copy of the [sheet template](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/12LEiHbvHoBa-dD7T63LOFe3aBadYyw7fdUGT1OFvG-0/copy).
- [ ] Install the Apify node (verified node on n8n Cloud, `@apify/n8n-nodes-apify` on self-hosted) and connect your Apify account in node 2.
- [ ] Connect OpenAI in node 3.
- [ ] Connect Google Sheets in **Read Logged Video IDs** and node 4 and pick your copy. The `Breakouts` tab is preset.
- [ ] Connect Slack in node 5 and pick a channel.
- [ ] Edit node 1, then run once by hand.

### Cost
A default run (3 searches, 10 videos each) costs about $0.01 on Apify plus one small gpt-5.4-mini call. `maxCostUsd` caps the Apify spend.

### Customization
Change the phrases, country, upload window (`today`, `week`, `month`, `year`) and thresholds in node 1, or the day and time in the schedule trigger.

## Start
Run by hand to test. The Monday 9:00 schedule only runs after you publish the workflow.

## Your settings
Edit only node 1: search phrases, country, upload window, thresholds and the Apify cost cap. The next node checks them before any paid request.

## Search YouTube
Runs the FetchCat YouTube search Actor, sorted by views, for each phrase. `maxCostUsd` caps the run cost.

## Score breakouts
Views per day are compared with the median of the same search. Videos already in your sheet are skipped. Nothing new: the run stops here with no writes.

## AI angles
One gpt-5.4-mini call groups the new breakouts into up to 5 topic angles. The answer is checked first; a bad answer stops the run with no writes.

## Deliver
Rows are added to or updated in the Breakouts tab by Video ID, then one Slack digest is posted.
